message.content:
Based on the image provided, here is a comprehensive design specification breakdown:

## **1. Overall Layout & Background**
- **Background Color**: Soft mint green (`#E8F5E9` or `#F0FDF4`)
- **Layout Structure**: Three-column asymmetric layout
  - **Left Column (40%)**: Hero copy and feature icons
  - **Center (35%)**: Mobile phone mockup (iPhone-style device)
  - **Right Column (25%)**: Feature cards with decorative text
- **Container**: Max-width ~1400px, centered with generous padding
- **Spacing**: Large whitespace between sections; elements use 24px-48px gaps

---

## **2. Typography System**

### **Primary Font Family**
- **Headings**: Bold Sans-serif (likely Inter, SF Pro Display, or similar geometric sans)
- **Body**: Regular weight of same family

### **Text Specifications**

**Hero Section:**
- **Label**: "CREATOR EARNINGS"
  - Size: 12-13px
  - Weight: 600 (Semibold)
  - Color: `#10B981` (Emerald Green)
  - Letter-spacing: 2-3px (uppercase)
  - Spacing: 16px below to headline

- **Main Headline**: "Same Day Payments,"
  - Size: 56-64px
  - Weight: 800 (ExtraBold/Black)
  - Color: `#0F172A` (Slate/Near Black)
  - Line-height: 1.1

- **Sub-headline**: "Every Day at 6 PM"
  - Size: 56-64px
  - Weight: 700 (Bold)
  - Color: `#059669` (Green-600) or `#10B981`
  - Line-height: 1.1

- **Body Copy**:
  - Size: 18-20px
  - Weight: 400 (Regular)
  - Color: `#475569` (Slate-600)
  - Line-height: 1.6
  - Max-width: ~480px

**Feature Cards (Right Side):**
- **Titles**: 20-22px, Bold (`#0F172A`)
- **Highlight Text** ("Every Day at 6:00 PM IST"): 24-26px, Bold, `#059669`
- **Descriptions**: 15-16px, Regular, `#64748B`

**Decorative Script Text** (Top Right):
- "Your Passion Pays" / "Create Connect Earn"
- Font: Handwritten script (similar to "Caveat", "Dancing Script", or custom brush)
- Color: `#059669` (Green)
- Size: 36-42px

**"How It Works" Section:**
- Label: 12px, uppercase, letter-spacing 2px, `#059669`
- Step Numbers: 32-36px, Bold, inside circles
- Step Titles: 18-20px, Bold, `#0F172A`
- Step Descriptions: 15px, Regular, `#475569`

---

## **3. Color Palette (Hex Codes)**

| Element | Hex Code | Usage |
|---------|----------|-------|
| **Primary Green** | `#10B981` | Icons, accents, labels |
| **Dark Green** | `#059669` | Headlines, emphasis text |
| **Light Green BG** | `#E8F5E9` / `#DCFCE7` | Page background, card backgrounds |
| **Mint/Cream** | `#F0FDF4` | Subtle backgrounds |
| **Dark Slate** | `#0F172A` | Primary headlines |
| **Medium Slate** | `#475569` | Body text |
| **Light Slate** | `#64748B` | Secondary descriptions |
| **White** | `#FFFFFF` | Phone screen background, card surfaces |
| **Success Green** | `#22C55E` | Positive numbers (+₹1,200) |

---

## **4. Mobile App UI (Phone Mockup)**

### **Device Frame**
- **Phone**: iPhone-style with rounded corners (radius ~40px)
- **Bezel**: Dark gray/black (`#1F2937`) with notch/camera cutout
- **Screen Background**: White (`#FFFFFF`)
- **Status Bar**: 
  - Time: "12:30"
  - Icons: Signal, WiFi, Battery (green)

### **App Header**
- **Background**: White
- **Title**: "Wallet" — Centered, 18px, Bold, `#0F172A`
- **Left Icon**: Back arrow `<—` (24px, `#0F172A`)
- **Right Icon**: Three dots menu (24px, `#0F172A`)

### **Balance Card**
- **Background**: Linear gradient from `#059669` to `#10B981` (Green gradient)
- **Border-radius**: 16px
- **Padding**: 20px
- **Content**:
  - "Total Balance": 14px, Medium, White (opacity 90%)
  - "₹12,580": 32px, Bold, White
  - Right arrow icon: White, 20px
- **Buttons Row**:
  - Two buttons side-by-side with 8px gap
  - **Withdraw Button**: White bg, Green text/icon
    - Icon: Bank/building outline + "Withdraw"
    - Text: 13px, Medium, `#059669`
    - Padding: 8px 16px, border-radius: 8px
  - **Transaction Button**: White bg, Green text/icon
    - Icon: List outline + "Transaction"
    - Same styling as Withdraw

### **Earnings Overview Section**
- **Header Row**: 
  - "Earnings Overview" (Left, 15px, Bold)
  - "This Week" + dropdown chevron (Right, 14px, `#64748B`)
- **Stats Grid**: 3 columns
  - **₹18,450** (Total Earnings): Green text, Bold, 16px
  - **₹5,870** (Withdrawn): Dark text, 16px
  - **₹12,580** (Available): Green text, Bold, 16px
  - Labels below each: 12px, `#64748B`, Medium

### **Recent Earnings List**
- **Section Header**: "Recent Earnings" (Left) / "See all" (Right, 14px, Green)
- **List Items** (3 visible):
  - Each item: Avatar circle (40px) + Text column + Amount
  - **Item 1**: 
    - Avatar: Female user photo
    - Title: "Live Stream Gift" (15px, Bold)
    - Subtitle: "4 Sep 2026, 10:24 PM" (13px, `#94A3B8`)
    - Amount: "+ ₹1,200" (15px, Bold, `#22C55E`)
  - **Item 2**: "Paid Stream" / "+ ₹800"
  - **Item 3**: "Tips" / "+ ₹350"

### **Bottom Navigation Bar**
- **Background**: White with top border (`#E2E8F0`)
- **Height**: 64px + safe area
- **Items** (5 columns):
  1. **Home**: House outline icon (unselected, `#94A3B8`)
  2. **Live**: Video camera/broadcast icon (unselected)
  3. **Plus/FAB**: Solid green circle (`#059669`), 48px diameter, white plus icon (+), elevated with shadow
  4. **Wallet**: Wallet icon (selected/filled, `#059669`) with label "Wallet" below in green
  5. **Profile**: User outline icon (unselected)
- **Labels**: 11px, below icons, matching icon color state

---

## **5. Left Column Features (3 Cards)**

Each feature has identical structure:
- **Icon Container**: Circle, 56px diameter, background `#DCFCE7` (light green), icon in `#059669`
- **Icon Details**:
  1. **Lightning bolt** (Fast Payouts)
  2. **Shield with checkmark** (Secure Transfers)
  3. **Bar chart** (Transparent Earnings)
- **Title**: 18-20px, Bold, `#0F172A`, margin-top 12px
- **Description**: 15px, Regular, `#64748B`, line-height 1.5, margin-top 4px

---

## **6. Right Column Feature Cards**

Three stacked cards with **light mint background** (`#F0FDF4` or `#ECFDF5`), border-radius 16px, padding 24px.

**Card 1: Payout Schedule**
- **Icon**: Calendar icon (outline, 32px, `#10B981`) in light green circle bg
- **Title**: "Payout Schedule" (20px, Bold)
- **Highlight**: "Every Day at 6:00 PM IST" (24px, Bold, `#059669`)
- **Description**: Gray text explaining daily processing

**Card 2: Low Platform Charge**
- **Icon**: Stacked coins (32px, `#10B981`)
- **Title**: "Low Platform Charge"
- **Big Number**: "9%" (36px+, ExtraBold, `#059669`)
- **Description**: "Only 9% platform charge..."

**Card 3: Safe & Compliant**
- **Icon**: Shield with check (32px, `#10B981`)
- **Title**: "Safe & Compliant"
- **Description**: Banking partner text

*Note: Decorative handwritten text floats above these cards on the right.*

---

## **7. "How It Works" Section (Bottom)**

- **Background**: White or very light gray
- **Layout**: Horizontal 4-step process with arrows between
- **Step Circles**: 
  - Diameter: 56px
  - Background: `#DCFCE7` (light green)
  - Number: 28px, Bold, `#059669`
- **Connector Arrows**: Right-pointing arrows (`→`) in light gray (`#CBD5E1`), 20px size
- **Step Content** (to the right of each circle):
  - **Step 1**: "Go Live & Earn" — "Receive gifts, tips and paid stream earnings."
  - **Step 2**: "Earnings in Wallet" — "Your earnings are added to your Trigger wallet."
  - **Step 3**: "Automatic Payout" — "Payouts are processed every day at 6:00 PM IST."
  - **Step 4**: "Receive in Bank" — "Amount is sent to your registered bank account."

**Footer Disclaimer**:
- Centered text below steps
- Size: 13-14px, color `#94A3B8` (Slate-400)
- Content: "Payout times may be affected by bank processing, verification, weekends, holidays or regulatory requirements."

---

## **8. Visual Effects & Details**

- **Shadows**: 
  - Phone mockup: Large soft shadow (0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25))
  - Cards: Subtle shadow (0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1))
  - FAB button: Elevated shadow (0 4px 12px rgba(5,150,105,0.4))
  
- **Border Radius Scale**:
  - Small elements (buttons, tags): 8px
  - Medium (cards, inputs): 12-16px
  - Large (phone, hero containers): 24-40px

- **Icon Style**: 
  - Outline style (stroke width 1.5-2px)
  - Rounded caps and joins
  - Consistent 24px grid for small icons, 32px for feature icons

This design follows a **modern fintech aesthetic** with high contrast between the dark slate typography and vibrant emerald greens, utilizing the phone mockup as a central focal point surrounded by trust-building information architecture.
